//: Codex CLI lifecycle hooks for the Compy repo. Codex hooks are a Stable, default-ON system (codex-rs/features: Feature::CodexHooks). Structure per the Codex contract: hooks.<EventName>[].matcher (regex over the Codex tool name) + .hooks[] with type:"command" (the ONLY executed type), command (POSIX shell) and commandWindows (native cmd.exe — used verbatim on Windows). Commands are resolved from the repo root (Codex runs hooks with CWD = the workspace root), so they stay relative — no hardcoded workstation path.
//readonly: This repo runs Codex as a READ-ONLY advisor (see AGENTS.md lane split). The single retained hook only INJECTS an advisory additionalContext string; it mutates nothing, spawns no build, and never authorizes install/ship/delete/commit. The Claude-lane automation (stop-continue, ship-reminder, subagent model/throttle guards, context-size advisor) was removed 2026-07-20 as not-Codex-native and/or not-read-only.
//activation: A green hooks-selftest exercises these scripts' own logic; it does NOT prove Codex activates them in-product. Only a trusted Codex runtime run proves in-product activation.
